MemBrain.title: MemBrain
MemBrain.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: MemBrains are much larger Brains that slowly move around the room and occasionally hop to fire 8 blood shots in all directions. They have a large amount of health and will split into two Brains upon death. Membrains deal a whole heart of damage with contact and projectiles.

sections.heading: Mama Guts
sections.text: Mama Guts are large versions of the regular Guts. They slowly move around the room, occasionally hopping and firing 8 large blood shots in all directions. Upon death, it splits into 2 Guts.

sections.heading: Dead Meat
sections.text: Dead Meats are bigger versions of the Cysts that move around the room slowly, occasionally hopping which fires 8 large blood shots in all directions that bounce off the walls like Rubber Cement. Upon death, they split into 2 Cysts.

sections.heading: Dinga
sections.text: Dingas are large Dips that behave similarly to MemBrains. Dingas slide around the room aimlessly and occasionally hop, spawning Dips or shooting poop shots in 8 directions. Splits into two Squirts when killed.

sections.heading: Mega Clotty
sections.text: Mega Clotties slowly move around the room, occasionally hopping. When one hops, it will usually fire six blood shots around itself, but it can also alternatively leave a puddle of Red Creep near itself. Even more rarely, the hop may spawn a Clotty or a collapsed Globin. Upon death, it’ll split into two Clotty. Even though the sprite shows three conjoined Clotties, it always creates two upon death, and will never spawn three.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • All monsters listed on this page deal one whole heart of contact damage except for Mega Clotty which deals half a heart of contact damage.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• MemBrain is a pun on the word membrane, which means a thin, flexible layer of body tissue.

• Mama Guts slightly resembles a digestive system.

• [Afterbirth onward] The Mega Clotty’s behavior coincidentally bears some resemblance to a fan idea of a boss called “Mega Clotty,” as, besides its name, this 2012 idea mentions that its behavior would be jumping up to shoot out blood shots as well as spawning one Clotty. However, the Mega Clotty is implemented as an enemy, not a boss, and some of its conceptual behaviors on the ideas wiki were never implemented for the fact that it’s purely coincidental. [end edition note]

Guts.title: Guts
Guts.attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Guts is a monster that attaches itself to a wall or obstacle, such as a rock, rolling around the contour of the terrain.
If the obstacle it is attached to is destroyed, then it will continue rolling in the direction it was previously traveling until it meets another wall or obstacle.

They make up for their limited movement by being very fast, and in numbers they can tighten movement space (especially in layouts containing narrow passages). Two of them are spawned by Mama Guts upon death.

sections.heading: Scarred Guts
sections.text: Scarred Guts are paler versions of the regular Guts. They have a 50% chance of replacing normal Guts in the Scarred Womb. They behave identically to regular Guts but leave behind a trail of damaging Red Creep and move slightly faster than their regular counterparts.

sections.heading: Slog
sections.text: Slogs are much darker than Guts and bear a yellow eye in their center that follows Isaac's position. Initially, they behave identically to Guts while moving slightly slower and leaving behind a trail of slowing Black Creep. However, when Isaac cardinally aligns with them, they charge at him until colliding with a wall or obstacle, where they will then resume their previous behavior. Slogs are exclusive to the Dank Depths.

sections.heading: Cyst
sections.text:
Cysts behave like normal Guts but they will occasionally shoot 1 blood shot towards Isaac if he is close enough.

Two of them will be spawned if a Dead Meat is killed.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Guts and their variants are immune to Strange Attractor's effect.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
• [Repentance] The Cyst first appeared in the Antibirth mod.

• Cysts in real life are abnormal growths, usually non-cancerous, filled with fluid or other semi-solid substances. Some even develop in organs or contain pores.
